title: Oozy Gooey Middle Eastern Chickpeas Tabbouleh
description: A plant-based twist on traditional tabbouleh, featuring gooey chickpeas and a dash of dashi extract, this dish is a nostalgic and funky take on Middle Eastern cuisine. It is perfect for a snack or light lunch.
instructions: Rinse the bulgur wheat in a fine mesh sieve and drain well.
In a large bowl, combine the bulgur wheat, parsley, mint, and scallions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dashi extract, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Pour the dressing over the bulgur mixture and toss to combine.
In a separate pan, heat the chickpeas over medium heat, stirring frequently, until they are lightly browned and fragrant.
Add the chickpeas to the bulgur mixture and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the tabbouleh a good stir and adjust the seasoning as needed.
